Case_05026/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Perirectal lesions secondary to herpes simplex virus, type 2 (HSV-2) are shown.

description.short_caption: Perirectal vesicular lesions suggestive of herpes simplex virus infection.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the perirectal region with multiple small, grouped vesicular lesions on an erythematous base. The lesions are well-demarcated and appear to be in varying stages of development, consistent with a viral etiology such as herpes simplex virus (HSV). The surrounding skin shows mild erythema without significant ulceration or necrosis.
